calls.title: Caue Guerra and Dan Wathne
calls.summary: The team is transitioning from Amplitude and Statsig to Growth Book to establish a better experimentation foundation due to issues with data access and integration. Caue Guerra highlighted Amplitude’s lack of Snowflake integration as a significant concern, leading to a search for a more robust platform. The Proof of Concept (POC) is nearing completion, pending security clearance, and the initial scope involves AA testing to ensure data accuracy. There’s a preference to start fresh rather than migrating data from Statsig, given the low volume of historical experiments and distrust in legacy data. Security clearance and Snowflake integration are priority items to facilitate data reliability and trust. The experimentation team, consisting of five engineers, will utilize a Slack channel for efficient communication during the transition.
calls.keywords: experiment platform migration, security review, POC approval, Snowflake integration, data validation, Growth Book
calls.action_items:
**Dan Wathne**
Set up an external Slack channel for communication with the Opendoor team to facilitate quicker collaboration (11:36)
Add Growth Book’s logistics and support team members (Logan, August, Natasha) to the external Slack channel to support the transition (12:22)
Send a POC kickoff call booking link to the Opendoor team after the security review is completed to align on objectives and timeline (17:44)
Develop and share a detailed POC checklist outlining steps, timelines, and resource allocation to guide the Proof of Concept process (14:30)

**Caue Guerra**
Follow up internally at Opendoor to complete the final security approval steps required for the POC agreement to proceed (11:21)
Provide specifics regarding the Amplitude contract renewal date to Growth Book to inform migration planning and avoid renewal (15:02)
Add relevant Opendoor team members to the newly created external Slack channels to enable effective collaboration with Growth Book (11:45)
Coordinate with product partners at Opendoor to decide on whether to migrate historical experiment data from Statsig or start fresh with Growth Book (16:14)
Engage with the new Chief Information Security Officer to clarify timelines and progress of the security review impacting the POC agreement (18:17)
